claims.text: NCEL achieves the best performance in most cases with an average gain of 2% on Micro F1 and 3% Macro F1.
NCEL consistently outperforms various baselines with a favorable generalization ability.
NN-based models, including NCEL, perform significantly better than most global models, indicating its effectiveness.
